已经有月余了吧，之前想录制一下通关纪念视频，结果一直回放超时失败，之前还以为是偶尔的情况，直到现在也不能用
不仅是看自己的录像，看别人的也不行，用的biubiu加速也是一样，想问下是什么情况

[English]
​Hi everyone, I'm new here! I wanted to try out the game, so I downloaded the mobile version and signed up using my Google account.

​However, after downloading all the game resources and tapping "Enter Mythag", I got a pop-up saying "You have reached the maximum numbers of characters allowed" and I can't progress any further.

​I searched online and found out this usually happens when you reroll (reset) too many times, but I swear today is literally my first time playing and I haven't rerolled even once.

​Has anyone experienced this or knows how to fix it? Any help would be greatly appreciated!

​[中文]
大家好，我是新玩家！很想体验这款游戏，所以下载了手机版，并用 Google 账号进行了注册。
​但是在下载完所有资源、点击“进入密斯卡托尼克大学”之后，弹出了 “角色创建数量已达上限” 的提示，没办法进行下一步。
​我上网查了一下，听说频繁重刷（刷初始）可能会出现这种情况。但我发誓今天真的是我第一次玩，一次都没有重刷过。
​请问有人遇到过这种情况或者知道怎么解决吗？非常感谢大家的帮助！

I'm aware there are people who likes Traphase. I am not one of them. 150 cards per season just feels like a drain to play through. The fact that it's a decently significant amount of silver and core rewards only compounds the issue.

My suggestion is to either move the silver and cores rewards to some other channel, or if it's important to have an incentive to get new players to try out the game mode, at least keep it light, such as 1 match played or just about 20~30 cards played. People who already like the game mode won't need the incentive. People who dislike it are just going to feel like it's a burden.

Another benefit to keeping the requirements light is that you can quickly filter out all the people in the matching pool who are just there for the rewards instead of caring about proper matches (that's me). Well, unless you're really really desperate to have people playing Traphase.
Request - Please lighten the requirement for the seasonal Silver rewards for Traphase
